messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer on prod reporting streaming JSON mode returns a truncated object mid-stream and their client JSON.parse fails. They only see it when traffic passes through their nginx reverse proxy + AWS ALB.

maria: Quick repro they gave (sanitized):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","stream":true,"json_mode":true,"prompt":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -R -s .
```

maria: What they get back is a big SSE stream but it ends like:
```
data: {"event":"delta","payload":{"tokens":[{"text":"...","role":"assistant"}]}}
data: {"event":"delta","payload":{"tokens":[{"text":"more text"}]}}
data: {"event":"delta","payload":{"tokens":[{"text":"truncated"}]}}
<data stream cuts off here — socket closed by upstream>
```

alex_support: Do we have any gateway logs for that time range? Also which runtime variant were they hitting (quantized vs fp16)?

maria: They said runtime rwd-v1-quant (dedicated), around 2025-11-12T13:02:10Z. Their nginx logs show: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream` and ALB recorded a 504 at the same minute.

jay: Preliminary causes: (1) proxy_read_timeout / ALB idle timeout too low so an intermittent stall causes upstream to be closed; (2) some proxies rewrite or buffer chunked SSE and can close when buffers hit limit; (3) client side abort on long streams.

ingram: Good checklist: ask customer to (A) bypass nginx (direct to API) for a quick test, (B) increase proxy_read_timeout & keepalive settings and ALB idle timeout to 120s+, (C) try curl --no-buffer / -N to ensure no client buffering, (D) capture tcpdump on the proxy to see FIN sequence.

maria: I sent those repro steps. They tried bypassing nginx (direct to API) and the stream stayed intact for >5 minutes. After increasing `proxy_read_timeout` from 30s -> 300s the truncation stopped.

alex_support: So likely a proxy/timeout-induced FIN. We should document this pattern in support KB: streaming JSON + intermediate proxies commonly need longer read/idle timeouts and to avoid buffer-based limiting. Also add note about ALB default 60s idle timeout.

jay: Can runtime improve diagnostics? We can add a short log marker when we close an active streaming connection (reason: client-abort vs server-initiated vs upstream error) so support can correlate with proxy logs. Filed internal ticket RINF-9125.

maria: Customer confirmed fix after timeout bump. Closing thread but leaving notes to update docs and add a KB snippet with config examples for nginx/ALB and a minimal curl repro that clearly shows how to reproduce and how to spot a proxy-induced close. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Note created: RINF-9125 (runtime stream close diagnostics).
